newsitem.title: EGYPT: Family of Egyptian beggars amass small fortune.
newsitem.headline: Family of Egyptian beggars amass small fortune.

text.p: An extended family of 30 beggars in the Egyptian town of Suez amassed a fortune of one million pounds ($290,000) until police rounded them up and confiscated the money, a government newspaper said on Tuesday.
Police stumbled across the fact that the beggars are related during a routine attempt to clear the streets of vagrants during the fasting month of Ramadan, al-Ahram said.

A cartoon in the newspaper showed a beggar lying on the pavement with his leg in plaster and talking to home on a mobile telephone. "Get dinner ready. I've almost finished work and I'll be coming straight away," he says.
The annual income of most of Egypt's population is about $1,000 a year.
